metadata.title: Quran Explained
metadata.description: Quran verses with Korean explanations of their context, word meanings, and a source for every explanation.

home.title: Understand the Quran in your language
home.intro: Each verse appears in Arabic with a Korean explanation of its context, an optional English view, the meaning of each word in that verse, and a link to the source of every explanation.
home.accountHint: You need an account to open the surah pages.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email before logging in.
errors.signupFailed: We could not create the account. Try again.
errors.confirmFailed: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Your email may already be confirmed, so try logging in.
